title: Merchant Onboarding KYC Verification
summary: Read merchant KYC packs, cross-check PAN, GSTIN, bank proof and the merchant's website, and give risk analysts a ready-to-decide file with every check explained.

seo.title: Merchant Onboarding KYC Verification with AI | VipraTech
seo.description: AI that reads merchant KYC documents, cross-checks PAN, GSTIN and bank details, reviews the website and prepares a decision file for risk analysts.

problem.intro: A payment aggregator onboarding a small merchant collects a PAN card, GST registration certificate, cancelled cheque or bank statement, address proof and, for companies and partnerships, incorporation documents and signatory details, plus the website or app the merchant will sell through. Analysts open each file, re-type names and numbers, and check that the legal name, GSTIN, bank account holder and website all describe the same business.

pain_points.title: Name and entity mismatches
pain_points.detail: The trade name on the GST certificate, the legal name on the PAN and the account holder on the cheque differ in small ways that analysts must resolve by hand.

pain_points.title: Website and business-model checks
pain_points.detail: Confirming that a merchant's site shows a real catalogue, terms, refund policy and contact details, and nothing on your prohibited list, is slow and inconsistent between analysts.

pain_points.title: Back-and-forth with sales
pain_points.detail: Missing pages and unreadable uploads are discovered days later, and the merchant is chased repeatedly through the sales team.

pain_points.title: Thin audit trail
pain_points.detail: When an auditor or partner bank asks why a merchant was approved, the reasoning sits in emails and analyst notes rather than a structured record.

solution.overview: We build a KYC review assistant that sits between your onboarding form and your risk analysts. It classifies each uploaded document, extracts the fields that matter and checks them against each other and against the verification sources you already use, such as GSTIN lookups and penny-drop bank account validation. A website review agent visits the merchant's URL and records what it finds: product categories, pricing, terms, refund and grievance policies, contact details and possible prohibited-category signals, with dated screenshots. The analyst receives one file with every check marked pass, fail or needs review. Missing or unreadable documents trigger a specific request back to the merchant.
capabilities: Classifies PAN, GST certificate, cancelled cheque, bank statement, partnership deed, incorporation certificate and address proof
Extracts legal and trade name, PAN, GSTIN, account number and IFSC, registered address and signatory details
Matches names and addresses across documents and explains each mismatch in plain words
Reviews the merchant website or app listing for catalogue, terms, refund and grievance policies and prohibited-category signals
Compares extracted data with GSTIN lookup and bank account validation responses from your existing providers
Drafts a specific missing-document request instead of a generic rejection

workflow.title: Collect the onboarding pack
workflow.detail: Documents and the merchant URL arrive from your onboarding form, CRM or partner portal and are grouped by application ID.

workflow.title: Classify and extract
workflow.detail: Each document is identified and its fields extracted, with a confidence score and page reference for every value.

workflow.title: Cross-check the entity
workflow.detail: Names, PAN, GSTIN, bank details and addresses are compared across documents and with the verification API responses you already receive.

workflow.title: Review the website
workflow.detail: An agent browses the merchant site read-only, captures screenshots and records catalogue, policy and risk-category observations.

workflow.title: Route by outcome
workflow.detail: Clean files go to a fast-track queue; mismatches, gaps and risk signals go to detailed review, and missing documents trigger a request.

workflow.title: Analyst decides
workflow.detail: The risk analyst approves, rejects or asks for more, and the decision is written back to your merchant system with its evidence.

inputs: PAN of the entity and its signatories
Cancelled cheque or recent bank statement
Incorporation certificate, partnership deed or shop establishment licence
Address proof and signatory ID, with masked Aadhaar where used
Merchant website or app store URL
outputs: Structured merchant profile with extracted fields
Check-by-check result: pass, fail or needs review
Website review notes with dated screenshots
Decision record with evidence links for audit
human_in_the_loop: Every merchant approval, rejection and risk categorisation is made by a risk analyst. The assistant prepares and explains the checks; it never activates a merchant or sets a risk category by itself.
integrations: Merchant onboarding or merchant management system (API)
Your existing GSTIN, PAN and bank account validation API providers
Document storage such as S3 or a DMS
Case management or ticketing tool for analyst queues
guardrails: Masked Aadhaar only; full Aadhaar numbers are never stored, per UIDAI rules
Only verification sources you are licensed to use, called through your existing providers
Website agent is read-only and records the date and URL of every screenshot
Field-level confidence thresholds agreed with your risk team
Regular sampling of fast-tracked files by a senior analyst
compliance_notes: Designed to support the merchant due diligence and record-keeping expected of payment aggregators under RBI directions.
Personal data of proprietors and signatories handled with purpose limitation and minimisation, in line with the DPDP Act 2023.

pilot.scope: One merchant segment, such as small online sellers onboarded through self-serve, using past applications whose outcomes are already known.
deliverables: KYC field schema and check list agreed with your risk team
Working extraction and cross-check pipeline on de-identified past applications
Website review agent configured for your prohibited-category list

what_we_measure.how: Compared with analyst-entered values for the same applications.
How often the system's flags match the issues analysts actually raised on those files.
Timed on a sample of applications with and without the prepared file.
Incomplete packs the system identified, checked against the document chases that actually happened.

faqs.q: Does this replace our verification API vendors?
faqs.a: No. It reads the documents and combines results from the GSTIN, PAN and bank validation vendors you already use. Face match and document tamper checks can be added as a separate step if you need them.

faqs.q: How does the website review handle sites that block bots or are still being built?
faqs.a: The agent records what it could and could not load and marks the check for analyst review. It never tries to bypass logins, captchas or other access controls.

faqs.q: Can it read regional-language documents such as shop establishment licences?
faqs.a: Yes, for printed text in common Indian languages, with low-confidence fields sent to an analyst. The pilot reports accuracy per document type so you can see where it is weaker.
It stays in your cloud account or an India region. We can use model endpoints that do not retain or train on your data, and personal details are masked in logs.
